title: Tasks Sidebar
description: Browse, run, and track workspace tasks from a dedicated Visual Studio Code sidebar.

title: Code Humanizer
description: Make AI-generated code look human, natural, or raw stone-age across C, C++, Python, JS, TS, HTML, and CSS with live preview.

title: Ghidra LSP
description: Browse and rename Ghidra symbols through ghidra-mcp

title: Kiro Threads for VSCode
description: Terminal-backed Kiro CLI threads in a sidebar, modelled on Zed's Terminal Threads.

title: Search Plus Plus
description: Search text and the key paths of YAML, JSON and TOML files. Typos and umlaut spellings match by default.

title: Stack Builder
description: Scan any folder, see every project inside it and the stack it uses, and turn it into a clean multi-root workspace with exactly the extensions each part needs.

title: Flow Pseudocode (FPC)
description: Flow Pseudocode (FPC) support: highlighting, errors as you type, format on save, and the cheat sheet for AI assistants.

title: Elflord (Vim Port)
description: A faithful port of Vim's "elflord.vim" colorscheme: black background, cyan text, bold and no-bold variants.

title: Socket Calm
description: A low-noise syntax theme in warm plum and sand. Six colors, no shouting — light and dark, straight from Socket's design system.

title: GXS Extension
description: Coloration, autocomplétion, erreurs en direct et aperçu pour les docs GX Studio (blocs @tip, @tabs, variables !nom, blocs custom...).

title: Toolchain Universal Mobile Runtime
description: Run your Android app on an emulator right inside VS Code: a live phone preview beside your code, build errors and crashes in the Problems panel, and Copilot agent tools. Kotlin, Java, Flutter and React Native.
